title: How to Cancel AT&T Internet: Steps, Fees and Equipment Return (2026)
description: How to cancel AT&T Fiber or AT&T Internet: call 800.288.2020, the early termination fee rule, the 21-day equipment return and $150 non-return fee, and what to try first. Checked November 27, 2026.
lead: What AT&T says about cancelling home internet, the fees to check and how to return equipment.
short_answer: AT&T says to cancel by calling 800.288.2020. The account owner calls during business hours with the account number and PIN. Equipment must come back undamaged within 21 days, and AT&T lists a $150 non-return fee, refunded if you return it within 6 months. An early termination fee applies only if you leave a term commitment after the first 14 days.

sections.body_html:
1. Line up the replacement first. Book your next provider's install date so you are not without internet.
  2. Check for a promotional or term commitment. AT&T says its Fiber and Internet Air plans do not require an annual contract, but AT&T's cancel page warns of penalties and fees if you cancel before a promotional commitment ends.
  3. If price is the reason, call first. See the AT&T call script. You may not need to switch.
  4. Gather your account number and PIN. AT&T says the account owner must have them to cancel.

sections.h2: How to cancel, according to AT&T
sections.body_html:
1. Call 800.288.2020. AT&T's cancel page says: "To cancel, call us at 800.288.2020."
  2. AT&T's cancellation policy says the account owner must call during business hours with the account number and PIN.
  3. Service stays active until the end of the bill period, per AT&T's cancel page.
  4. AT&T says customers who ordered Internet Air online may be able to cancel online at att.com/myatt in some states (we saw Illinois, Massachusetts and New York named). AT&T's price-change page also offers online chat for customers who want to cancel.

AT&T's cancellation policy says an early termination fee applies only if you disconnect after the first 14 days while under a term commitment, and that it is prorated and reduced for each month your service is active. AT&T's policy gives a worked example of a $180 fee on a 12-month term that is reduced each month. Ask the agent for your exact fee and how it is calculated before you confirm.

AT&T says equipment must be returned undamaged within 21 days of cancellation, and that wall-mounted equipment stays in place. AT&T lists a non-return fee of $150 per its cancellation policy, which it says is refunded if the equipment is returned within 6 months of termination. Damage fees are not refunded. Ask the agent how to return it and keep your receipt or tracking number.

Check your final bill for equipment charges and any early termination fee. To choose a new provider, compare providers at your address and check the price after the promotion. Our promo-end reminder can call you before the new price starts.

faq: How do I cancel AT&T internet?
AT&T says to call 800.288.2020. The account owner calls during business hours with the account number and PIN.
Does AT&T charge an early termination fee?
Only if you disconnect after the first 14 days while under a term commitment. It is prorated and falls each month; AT&T's policy gives a $180 example on a 12-month term. Ask for your exact amount.
How long do I have to return AT&T equipment?
AT&T says equipment must be returned undamaged within 21 days of cancellation. A $150 non-return fee applies and is refunded if you return it within 6 months.
Can I cancel AT&T internet online?
AT&T says customers who ordered Internet Air online may be able to cancel at att.com/myatt in some states. For AT&T Fiber and AT&T Internet, AT&T directs cancellations to 800.288.2020.
